## About
Anointed Hands Automotive is a full service auto shop on Poplar Grove St in Baltimore. Whether your car needs a brake repair, a muffler replacement or just an oil change, we want to take care of it honestly and without a long wait.
We work on domestic and foreign makes and models, plus light truck and SUV repair. We believe your needs and satisfaction come first, and we're committed to running this shop in an ethical, sound way.
One reviewer calls him Brother Julius. Others describe the man doing the work as honest, humble and meticulous. We're rated 4.9 on Google from 29 reviews.

## Services
- Brake Service: Brake repair and service to keep you stopping safely.
- Oil Changes: Routine oil changes as part of keeping your car maintained.
- Auto Tune Ups: Tune ups to keep your engine running right.
- Wheel Alignments: Alignment work so your car drives straight and your tires wear evenly.
- Tire Service: Tire service for everyday drivers.
- Air Conditioning Service (A/C): A/C service to keep the cabin comfortable.
- Transmission Service: Transmission service and repair, along with exhaust and suspension work.
- Light Trucks and SUV Repair: Light truck and SUV repair, not just cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on both domestic and foreign makes and models.

Q: Do you accept extended warranties?
A: Yes, our site lists that we accept extended warranties. Give us a call to talk through your coverage.

Q: Are your prices fair?
A: One reviewer called our prices reasonable, and another wrote that we are very reasonable in pricing work.
